title: Dynamic prediction of incident postoperative acute kidney injury in surgical intensive care
description: Reproducible code for dynamic prediction of serum-creatinine-defined incident postoperative acute kidney injury using MIMIC-IV and eICU, including temporal and external validation, recalibration, competing-risk sensitivity analyses, and selection-bias sensitivity analyses. No patient-level data are included.
